source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 21 - Caster with Locking Brake (New).pdf
title: Casters With Locking Brake
lead: MOC now has casters with the added feature of a locking brake (Part No. 94341).
body: This new caster is the same as the current caster (Part No. 94285) with the exception of the locking brake. This caster is compatible with all of our machines.
This caster is now on shelf and available to purchase.
